Structural governance/buyback bid and upgraded FY26 GDP (~0.8%) support the long leg. Honest caveats sized accordingly: ratio already 82.5th percentile, foreign flows negative (-¥392.5bn latest week), core-core CPI soft at 1.7%, and a disorderly carry-unwind yen spike (Aug-2024 analog) is the bear case — hence 2% and a patient entry rather than standard-size at market.
